svg.title: Release: you start it and merge one pull request; the rest runs on its own
svg.desc: Three columns: you, a model, and the bots and scripts. Start: Release prep in Kitden's Actions; Gather the changes: log, merged pull requests, diff since the last tag; Claude drafts: the release notes, README, policy edits; Check and prepare: set the version, record the README pictures on macOS; Beacon: opens the pull request Kitden X.Y.Z; Review: and merge it; Beacon: tags vX.Y.Z; Build and test: on Linux and macOS, then PyPI and the GitHub release; Beacon: moves the release branch (Claude directory, marketplaces), opens the Homebrew pull request; MCP Registry: published with GitHub's token, then one table of every store; Kettle, every day: keeps the Homebrew formula up to date; Lantern, every day: an issue when a store is behind or a release is due.
